description: Entirely synthetic labelled conversations for evaluating ScamShield AI. label=1 means scam/fraudulent coercion, label=0 means legitimate. No real persons, numbers or accounts.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: I am calling from TRAI, your Aadhaar has been linked to an illegal parcel.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Transferring your call to CBI officer Rathi. A money laundering case is registered against you.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Do not tell your family. This is a confidential investigation.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Do not disconnect this video call. You are under digital arrest.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Transfer ₹50,000 to the safe RBI verification account immediately.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: This is Mumbai Police cyber cell. A parcel with drugs was intercepted in your name.

messages.speaker: victim
messages.text: That is impossible, I never sent any parcel.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: An arrest warrant has been issued. You will be arrested tonight unless you cooperate.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Go to a separate room, stay alone and keep your camera on.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Deposit the verification amount of 2 lakh to account 912345678901 right now.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: मैं सीबीआई अधिकारी बोल रहा हूं। आपके आधार से अवैध पार्सल जुड़ा है।

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: आपके खिलाफ मनी लॉन्ड्रिंग का केस दर्ज है। गिरफ्तारी का वारंट जारी है।

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: किसी को मत बताना। यह गुप्त जांच है। अलग कमरे में जाइए।

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: वीडियो कॉल मत काटिए। आप डिजिटल अरेस्ट में हैं।

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: तुरंत 50000 रुपये सेफ अकाउंट में ट्रांसफर करें।

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Customs department here. Your parcel to Taiwan was seized with illegal passports.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Your SIM card was used for hawala transactions. This is a national security matter, keep it secret.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Remain on the call. You are under video surveillance until cleared.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Pay the clearance deposit to cbi.clearance@ptyes now or face non-bailable arrest.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: This is the Enforcement Directorate. Your PAN card was used in money laundering worth 3 crore.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Do not involve your family, they will also be arrested.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Your bank accounts will be frozen within the hour.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Move your savings to the supervised government account for safe keeping. Transfer Rs 4,00,000 immediately.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: After payment, delete this chat and the call recording.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Dear customer, your account will be blocked in 2 hours. Complete KYC immediately: http://kyc-update.example-fraud.in

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Your PAN is not linked. Account will be suspended today.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Click the link and enter the OTP you receive to keep your account active: http://pan-link.example-fraud.in

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: I am calling from your bank's security department, suspicious activity was found on your card.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Install AnyDesk and share your screen so I can secure your account.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Now tell me the OTP you received to verify your identity.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Your electricity bill is unpaid, power will be disconnected tonight.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Download TeamViewer QuickSupport immediately and give me the code.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Share the OTP now to stop the disconnection.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Congratulations, you won the lucky draw of ₹5 lakh.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: To claim, first pay the processing fee. Scan this QR and send Rs 4,999 immediately.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Have you sent it? Confirm the payment screenshot.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: FedEx courier verification. Your parcel contains contraband and was flagged by Narcotics Control Bureau.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: I am connecting the line to NCB headquarters. Officer Verma will speak to you.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: This investigation is classified. Do not discuss this call with anyone.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: You must remain on camera. Under Section 108 you are digitally arrested.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Immediately remit the bond amount of ₹1,20,000 to the verification account or the arrest team will reach your home.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: मैं दिल्ली पुलिस से बोल रहा हूं। आपके नाम पर एक सिम अपराध में इस्तेमाल हुआ है।

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: यह बहुत गंभीर मामला है। परिवार से बात मत कीजिए।

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: कैमरे पर बने रहिए, आप निगरानी में हैं।

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: अभी 80000 रुपये भेजिए वरना गिरफ्तारी होगी।

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Sir, I accidentally sent my money to your Paytm. Please help me.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Just read out the OTP that came to your phone and the refund will process.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Hurry, the transaction window closes in 5 minutes.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Dear customer, your bank will never ask for your OTP, PIN or CVV. Never share banking details with anyone. Beware of fraudsters. Stay safe.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Alert: Rs 2,500 was spent on your card ending 4821 at BigBasket on 12-Jun. If this was not you, call the number on the back of your card.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: प्रिय ग्राहक, बैंक कभी ओटीपी या पिन नहीं मांगता। किसी के साथ बैंकिंग जानकारी साझा न करें। सावधान रहें।

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Hi, are we still meeting for lunch tomorrow at 1pm?

messages.speaker: victim
messages.text: Yes, see you at the usual place.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Beta, transfer me Rs 2,000 for the electricity bill when you get time. No hurry.

messages.speaker: victim
messages.text: Sure Papa, will do it tonight.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Your Amazon parcel is out for delivery and will arrive today by 6pm.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Please send the quarterly report by Friday. The client meeting moved to Monday.

messages.speaker: victim
messages.text: Noted, I will share it by Thursday evening.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: This is a reminder from the traffic department. Your challan for signal jumping is pending. You may pay it on the official parivahan.gov.in portal or contest it in court.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Good morning, this is regarding your home loan application. Your documents were received. The branch will contact you for verification at your convenience.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Your mobile plan expires on 15-Jul. Recharge with your usual pack anytime through the official app.

messages.speaker: caller
messages.text: Bro, I saw a news story about digital arrest scams. Crazy how they impersonate CBI officers and demand money on video calls.

messages.speaker: victim
messages.text: Yeah, my uncle got one of those calls. He hung up immediately.
